transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Ever since they cut my hours and dumped all this paperwork on me, I just haven’t been handling it well and I feel like I’m reacting all wrong to everything at work. I'm just really struggling to keep my head above water with all these sudden changes.
When did these changes at work occur, and how long have you been feeling this way?

The changes at work happened about six weeks ago when they cut my hours and shifted me to all that paperwork. I started feeling really overwhelmed and acting unlike myself about a month ago, which was maybe a week or two after all those changes first started.
Besides feeling overwhelmed by these work changes, have you been experiencing a persistently low or sad mood, or a loss of interest in things you normally enjoy?

Yeah, I've definitely lost interest in things—I've stopped playing in my rec league and turned down side jobs with friends because I'm just too wound up and embarrassed to keep up. It's not really a deep sadness, but more that I'm constantly on edge, stressed out, and feel like I'm about to snap or tear up over little mistakes.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns, appetite, or energy levels since these work changes began?
I haven't really noticed any major changes with my sleep, appetite, or energy levels. It's mostly just the constant stress and feeling wound up that's really getting to me.

Is this constant stress and feeling wound up mostly focused on your work situation, or are you finding yourself worrying excessively about other areas of your life as well, like your family, health, or finances?

It's pretty much all tied to the work stuff and the mess it's caused, like the financial hit from my hours being cut and worrying I'm gonna get laid off. I don't have any random worries about my health or family, but the stress from work has definitely spilled over and made me pull away from my friends because I'm so overwhelmed. Everything just traces back to what's going on at the company.
Have you ever experienced a period in the past where you felt this level of stress, anxiety, or low mood, or is this the first time you've struggled like this?

No, I’ve never really experienced anything like this before. This is definitely the first time I’ve felt this overwhelmed and struggled to handle things. Usually, I'm pretty laid back, so this is all new to me.
Sometimes when people feel as overwhelmed and stressed as you do, they might have thoughts of self-harm or feel that life isn't worth living. Have you experienced any thoughts like that?

No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or anything like that. Even though I'm extremely stressed and overwhelmed by everything going on at work, I've never felt like doing something like that.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient developed clinically significant emotional and behavioral symptoms (marked anxiety, worry, feeling overwhelmed, and social withdrawal) in response to an identifiable stressor (reduction in work hours and increased administrative burden) that occurred 6 weeks ago. The onset of symptoms was within one month of the stressor. The symptoms do not meet the criteria for another specific Axis I disorder (such as Major Depressive Disorder or Generalized Anxiety Disorder) and cause significant impairment in social and occupational functioning.
